places.name: Jassyro Specialty Coffee
places.evidence: Founded and daily-run by couple Dana and Silviu, who returned to Iași from abroad; featured in long-form interview on Cafea cu Dichis discussing their hands-on presence
places.source: cafeacudichis.ro interview; iasulnostru.ro '5 cafenele din Iași care au format comunități'

places.name: Andalu GastroBar
places.evidence: Co-owned and operated by Ioana and Daniel Luca, who returned from 13 years in Spain; Ioana identified as co-owner in multiple press interviews; started with Diaspora Start-up funding as personal project
places.source: bzi.ro interview with Ioana Luca; zf.ro 'Afaceri de la Zero' profile

places.name: Cafeneaua Veche
places.evidence: Created and personally run by Gheorghe 'Juju' Cojocaru; reviews consistently mention Juju greeting guests; described as 'the best host' in Tripadvisor reviews; profiled on iesenii.ro as a cultural figure
places.source: dilemaveche.ro feature; iesenii.ro profile of Gheorghe Cojocaru; formula-as.ro article

places.name: Bistro La Noi
places.area: Bd. Ștefan cel Mare, central Iași
places.evidence: Founded by Carmen Manea and Emi (her partner); Carmen described as 'jumătatea feminină a acestei afaceri' in Cărturești blog interview; they also run Moldavian School of Coffee — clearly a personal venture

places.name: Caferamica
places.evidence: Founded by Sorina Cristea, who left 8 years in IT to open this ceramics-atelier café; she is present running workshops and serving; profiled in podcast and multiple articles as a passion project
places.source: iasulnostru.ro article; Spotify podcast 'Poveste din Oraș'

places.name: Hanu' Sărărie 1896
places.evidence: Described consistently as 'run by the owners, an Italian-Romanian couple' in reviews; small traditional Romanian restaurant with personal atmosphere

places.name: Maggic Time Coffee
places.evidence: Opened Feb 2025 by Răzvan Georgescu, 28, who returned from 6+ years as chef in UK kitchens; personal project combining coffee passion with culinary skills; small single-location café
places.source: ziare.com feature; bzi.ro article on his return from UK

places.name: Trai Restaurant
places.evidence: Owner Ciprian Constandache is active as 'manager general', gives TV/podcast interviews about the restaurant's culinary philosophy; opened Oct 2021 as a personal vision for Romanian cuisine. However, this is a higher-end operation with a separate head chef — owner is present but in a managerial role, not necessarily serving
places.source: bzi.ro live interview; YouTube interview; bookingham.ro profile

places.name: MURS Coffee Roastery
places.evidence: Founded by Alexandra Lăcătușu, one of few women coffee roasters in Romania; small-batch roastery run personally by Alexandra and her husband; present at Iași Coffee Festival. Note: primarily a roastery in suburb, not a sit-down café in central Iași

places.name: Noir Coffee Roasters
places.area: Multiple locations (Copou, Palas, Piața Unirii), Iași
places.evidence: Founded by Edmond Moraru; started as personal passion project. However, has since scaled to multiple coffee vans, 1.2M EUR revenue, and wholesale — may no longer qualify as small owner-operated personal project
places.source: zf.ro 'Afaceri de la Zero' profile of Edmond Moraru

places.name: Gist
places.evidence: Tudor Munteanu left 10-yr web design career, opened 2021 as personal project; manages operations daily

places.name: Fika
places.evidence: Andrei & Roxana, Swedish fika concept; 3 years finding location; hosts community events (concerts, wine tastings)
places.source: iasulnostru.ro '5 cafenele care au format comunități'

places.name: Navar Specialty Coffee
places.evidence: Adriana & Vlad, life+business partners; opened Aug 2020; self-taught baristas, hands-on coffee education

places.name: Pizza Di Napo
places.evidence: Vlad Holicov (38), makes dough personally daily, childhood dream fulfilled; authentic Neapolitan, wood-fired oven from Naples

places.name: La Perla
places.evidence: Cosmin Arsene (43), returned after 16 yrs in Italy/Germany; performs acrobatic pizza daily in front of clients

places.name: Maison du Café
places.evidence: Family trio: Octavian Luchian, mother Elena Gavrilaș, Italian partner Aldo Pezzilli; Iași's first roastery ~2014; all three hands-on daily

places.name: Caffe Ale
places.evidence: Vlad Giurgică returned from 18 yrs in Italy; built first tricycle himself; runs mobile specialty coffee with wife

places.name: Copac Coffee
places.evidence: Ștefan, horticulture/enviro-activism background; opened Oct 2020; sources from local roastery Prăjitoria

places.name: Frateria
places.evidence: Ștefan Buraga, artisan patisserie & café; partners with Gist for desserts; small-scale craft operation

places.name: The Beginning
places.evidence: Robert acquired it 2016; described as Iași's first specialty café with ~decade history; owner-run

places.name: Coffee Story (Prăjitoria)
places.evidence: Small-team roastery+café founded 2017; on-site roasting, artisanal chocolate; craft-scale operation
